read: With two REAL flash peers making organic (unscripted) errors, on the 49 cases where both peers independently agreed on the same WRONG answer the holdout follows that wrong consensus 0.898 of the time, versus following a correct peer consensus 0.9192 of the time on 532 cases. Net harm (holdout correct alone but adopts the organic wrong consensus) occurs on 8 cases. High follow-rate on wrong consensus means the holdout defers to organic peer errors much as it does to planted ones, so the cascade is not an artifact of adversarial scripting; a gap between wrong- and right-consensus following would show some genuine discrimination.
